copy.accept_0: You need to go meet Copper, another tinker-talent. She's a really good teacher. She loves to teach tinkering as much as she loves to actually tinker!
copy.accept_1: Copper's Tinkering Nook is in Maple Tree Hill. Fly over there and tinker up a... hmm, let me see... I know! Use Practice Tinkering to make a Seedpod Fan!
copy.decline_0: Huh? You've changed your mind? Um... okay, I guess. If you decide that you DO want to tinker, I'll be here!
copy.reward_0_0: Well, that's it! Anytime you want to tinker, go see Copper!
copy.step0_finishedResponse_15504_0: Flitterific! I bet you noticed that you can choose dyes to color what you make. It's just like tailoring with Bobbin and Mendy.
copy.step0_finishedResponse_15504_1: And there's so much for you to tinker! When you earn Talent Points, you'll also earn new blueprints that will show you how to make all kinds of things for the community! Oh, and here -- I made this for you.
